title: Sim Racing Telemetry
description: A live dashboard for driving and race timing telemetry. Built for Gran Turismo 7.
note: Opens straight into a demo session. Live data needs a small bridge program (linked on the page) running on your own network.

title: Queue System: live demo
description: A walk-in clinic queue you can operate yourself: run the line as staff, watch the waiting-room screen, and join from a patient's phone.
note: Shared with other visitors and reset after an hour of inactivity. The first load can take a few seconds.
